title: 第80 章天高三尺

第80 章天高三尺-《穿越60带着空间当保安》

用十斤棒子面换了四十个蛤蟆干，王野高高兴兴的回了招待所，一觉睡到天亮，这次孙叔没有出去，正靠在床头上看不知道哪来的书。

看到王野醒了，孙叔笑呵呵的说：“还是年轻好呀，睡得真香。今天还要出去吗？”

王野挠了挠头说：“孙叔，今天我要去远点的地方，就不回来了，明天你和他们回四九城就好了。”

孙叔点点头也不细问，不论什么时候好奇心都会害死猫的，年纪越大的人好奇心越会被克制。只是又一次嘱咐注意安全。

王野出了招待所，王野直奔供销社，在这里王野用昨晚换的票买了一身秋冬季的外衣，还买了一件军大衣，这种军大衣太适合进山了，结实，暖和。最重要的是王野还买了一床被褥。交钱和票后王野背着一个麻袋出了供销社。

骑上车子王野直奔长白山，这次王野要进山了，而且计划要在山里待5天。一路王野骑的并不快，离城越远，人迹越罕见，一直骑到山脚下没有路后王野才下了自行车。

把自行车和麻袋收进空间，就这样轻身简行进入了森林。一进森林王野就开始隔一会用精神力探查一遍，在森林的外围，什么东西都没有，王野知道这都是附近的村民把这里采干净了。

王野也不着急，一直往深处走，一般的小猎物王野不感兴趣，这次王野主要目的是为了人参和虎骨，当然要是有合适的他也来者不拒。

就这样走了大半天王野发现这里的树木更粗大了，茂密的树木让林间显得有些昏暗，但是在王野的精神力下所有的动物，药材都无所遁形。

可是大部分都是不太值钱的东西，在后世都很常见，唯一比较值钱的应该就是找到了几株天麻，就这样王野不急不慢的一直往深处走，直到精神力探测出一群野猪。

长白山的野猪可比四九城的大多了，这群野猪有十头，四大六小。大的王野目测得有三百来斤，这还能放过，王野悄悄的爬上一棵大树，从空间里取出大八粒上好子弹打开保险又收了回去，再把56半拿出打开保险。

一切准备就绪，王野精神力全开，先瞄准一头最大的，毫不犹豫开枪射击，连续十枪六枪命中。换枪继续又是八枪，只命中了两头。王野就这还不知足，四大四小八头野猪王野不到三十秒就放倒了。

王野不要脸的想着，要是有机会一定要去大草原上打猎，在森林里太影响发挥了。就这战绩要让别的猎人看见得羡慕死，他这三十秒，都顶上人家大半年的收获了。

老规矩，取出长棍一头头的收进空间。这次王野想钓下鱼，在空间里把一头大肥猪的血全都放了出来，全都散在了这片地上。然后三下五除二的又爬上了刚才那棵大树。

上了树王野从空间里取出食物开始吃饭了，大肉包子王野几口就一个，就这样吃着包子精神力探查这周围，一等就是一个多小时。

After exchanging ten pounds of stick noodles for forty dried toads, Wang Ye returned to the guest house happily and slept until dawn. Uncle Sun did not go out this time, and was leaning on the bedside to read a book he didn't know where he had come from.

Seeing Wang Ye wake up, Uncle Sun said with a smile: "It's better to be young. I slept so soundly. Do you want to go out today?"

Wang Ye scratched his head and said, "Uncle Sun, I'm going somewhere far away today and won't come back. You can just go back to Sijiu City with them tomorrow."

Uncle Sun nodded without asking. Curiosity will kill the cat at any time. The older people are, the more their curiosity will be restrained.Just another reminder to be careful.

Wang Ye left the guest house and went straight to the supply and marketing cooperative. Here Wang Ye used the tickets he exchanged last night to buy an autumn and winter coat, and also bought a military coat. This kind of military coat is perfect for going into the mountains. It is strong and warm.The most important thing is that Wang Ye also bought a quilt.After paying the money and the ticket, Wang Ye left the supply and marketing cooperative carrying a sack.

Wang Ye got on his bike and headed straight to Changbai Mountain. This time Wang Ye was going into the mountains and planned to stay in the mountains for 5 days.Wang Ye didn't ride very fast all the way. The further away from the city, the rarer the human footprints became. Wang Ye didn't get off the bike until there was no road at the foot of the mountain.

Putting the bicycle and sack into the space, he entered the forest with ease.As soon as he entered the forest, Wang Ye began to use his mental power to explore it every once in a while. There was nothing on the outskirts of the forest. Wang Ye knew that this was all plucked by nearby villagers.

Wang Ye was not in a hurry and kept walking deeper. Wang Ye was not interested in ordinary small prey. This time Wang Ye's main purpose was to get ginseng and tiger bones. Of course, if there were suitable ones, he would not refuse them.

After walking like this for a long time, Wang Ye found that the trees here were thicker. The dense trees made the forest look a little dark, but under Wang Ye's mental power, all the animals and medicinal materials were invisible.

But most of them are not very valuable things, which are very common in later generations. The only thing that is more valuable is to find a few gastrodia elata. In this way, Wang Ye walked deeper and unhurriedly until he detected a group of wild boars with his mental power.

The wild boars in Changbai Mountain are much larger than those in Sijiu City. There are ten wild boars in this group, four big and six small.The big Wang Ye weighed about three hundred kilograms by visual inspection, so he could still let it go. Wang Ye quietly climbed up a big tree, took out eight good bullets from the space, opened the safety and put them back, then took out the 56 and opened the safety.

Everything was ready, Wang Ye was full of energy, he aimed at the largest one first, shot without hesitation, and hit six of ten consecutive shots.He changed his gun and fired eight more shots, only hitting two of them.Wang Ye was not satisfied with this. Four big, four small and eight wild boars were knocked down by Wang Ye in less than thirty seconds.

Wang Ye thought shamelessly that if he had the chance, he would definitely go hunting on the prairie. Being in the forest would have too much impact on his performance.This achievement would make other hunters jealous to death. His thirty seconds were equal to what others had achieved in half a year.

Follow the old rule, take out the long stick and put it into the space end by end.This time Wang Ye wanted to catch a fish and released all the blood of a big fat pig in the space, scattering it all on the ground.Then he climbed up the big tree again.

After climbing into the tree, Wang Ye took out the food from the space and started eating. Wang Ye only took a few bites of the big meat buns. He just ate the buns and mentally explored the surroundings. He waited for more than an hour.
